description: The text did not arrive: email a new code for the same pending verification (one id, one charge). The emailed code replaces the texted one and is checked by the email address, which it proves (not the phone). Once per verification.

channel.description: The channel to fall back to. Only `email` today.

email.description: The address to email the code to

user_ip.description: Optional. Your end user's IP address, counted in the same per-IP limit as POST /verify.

name: fallback_verification
title: Fallback verification
